name: HSBC Holdings plc
_sources_used: HSBC Annual Report and Accounts 2024 (Companies House + hsbc.com IR)
HSBC Full Year 2024 Results announcement (19 Feb 2025)

kpis.description_fr: Revenu opérationnel net total HSBC. Hausse modérée FY24 reflète normalisation post-pic taux 2023.
kpis.description_en: Total HSBC net operating income. Moderate FY24 increase reflects normalization post-2023 rate peak.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu d'intérêt net. Recul FY24 face baisse anticipée des taux et compression NIM.
kpis.description_en: Net interest income. FY24 decline from anticipated rate cuts and NIM compression.

kpis.description_fr: Résultat net record FY24 grâce à pic de revenu d'intérêt et cessions stratégiques (Canada, US Mass Market, Argentine).
kpis.description_en: Record FY24 net income from interest revenue peak and strategic divestments (Canada, US Mass Market, Argentina).

kpis.description_fr: Net Interest Margin. KPI maître des banques: spread entre taux prêts et coûts de financement.
kpis.description_en: Net Interest Margin. Master KPI for banks: spread between lending rates and funding costs.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio de solvabilité réglementaire (Bâle III). Largement au-dessus seuil 11.0%. Marge confortable pour dividendes et buybacks.
kpis.description_en: Basel III regulatory solvency ratio. Well above 11.0% threshold. Comfortable buffer for dividends and buybacks.

kpis.description_fr: Encours de prêts aux clients. Baisse FY24 due aux cessions Canada + Argentine + sortie US Mass Market.
kpis.description_en: Customer loan book. FY24 decline due to Canada + Argentina divestments + US Mass Market exit.

kpis.description_fr: Dépôts clients. Stable malgré contraction loans, indique fort funding base global.
kpis.description_en: Customer deposits. Stable despite loan contraction, indicates strong global funding base.

kpis.description_fr: Coûts opérationnels rapportés aux revenus. Cible <55%. Programme de transformation simplification continue.
kpis.description_en: Operating costs over revenues. Target <55%. Ongoing simplification transformation program.

kpis.description_fr: Mesure de rentabilité bancaire. Cible mid-teens. Performance solide FY24 malgré environnement compétitif.
kpis.description_en: Banking profitability metric. Mid-teens target. Solid FY24 performance despite competitive environment.

kpis.description_fr: Dividende total y compris dividende spécial $0.21 lié cession Canada. Programme buyback supplémentaire $2Mds.
kpis.description_en: Total dividend including special $0.21 dividend from Canada divestment. Additional $2B buyback program.

kpis.description_fr: Capital Tier 1 réglementaire. Couvre absorption de pertes et exigences Bâle III. Position solide.
kpis.description_en: Regulatory Tier 1 capital. Covers loss absorption and Basel III requirements. Strong position.
